entries.description: Created docs/planning/platform-ui-foundation-review-ledger.md with the Session 1 surface inventory covering DabblerQueryPage, DabblerDataGrid, DabblerFilterGrid, DabblerShell, DabblerNavigationPanel, and DabblerTabbedWorkspace, grounded in current app usage, UAT findings, and existing direct tests.
Ran a routed framework-alignment analysis comparing the reusable UI surfaces against MudBlazor 8.15.0, including overlap, durable value, and framework-coupling risk.
Ran a routed friction scan connecting the current UAT findings, navigation behavior, filter interactions, and test gaps to the reusable surfaces most responsible for operability and UX problems.

Used a routed documentation pass to shape the Session 1 keep/simplify/rethink ledger and handoff topics, then finalized the durable planning note in docs/planning/platform-ui-foundation-review-ledger.md.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln successfully with one pre-existing nullable warning in tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests/WebGuardrailTests.cs. The first dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln run surfaced one transient Playwright failure in E2E_WF_05_SystemAdmin_AddsProductAfterKeyboardAndValidationChecksAsync; a targeted rerun of that test passed, and a full rerun of tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright.csproj passed all 10 Playwright tests.
Completed mandatory external session verification with verdict ISSUES_FOUND.
Ran a second external verification round after minor documentation and logging follow-ups; verifier returned VERIFIED.
